After each run you are shown the result and a picture of the scene, and you reply with another code block that fixes or adds to it. The scene is kept between runs; Python variables and functions are not.

Make the farewell at the airfield from Casablanca: night, fog, the propeller plane waiting, the two of them in hats and coats, a car and the hangar behind. Be detailed: build every part of the scene, and keep adding and refining detail for as long as you can.

```python
import bpy
import math
import random
from mathutils import Vector

# Clean the scene
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')

# Set up scene properties
scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.film_transparent = False

# Set world background to dark night with fog color
world = bpy.data.worlds.get("World")
if not world:
    world = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
    scene.world = world
world.use_nodes = True
nodes = world.node_tree.nodes
links = world.node_tree.links
nodes.clear()

bg_node = nodes.new('ShaderNodeBackground')
bg_node.inputs[0].default_value = (0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 1.0)  # Dark blue night
bg_node.inputs[1].default_value = 1.0
out_node = nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputWorld')
links.new(bg_node.outputs[0], out_node.inputs[0])

# Set up camera
cam_data = bpy.data.cameras.new("Camera")
cam_data.lens = 35
cam = bpy.data.objects.new("Camera", cam_data)
scene.collection.objects.link(cam)
cam.location = (8, -15, 3)
cam.rotation_euler = (math.radians(85), 0, math.radians(15))
scene.camera = cam

# Set up fog
scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value = (0.03, 0.04, 0.06, 1.0)
scene.world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value = 1.0

# Add volume fog to world
vol_node = nodes.new('ShaderNodeVolumePrincipled')
vol_node.inputs['Color'].default_value = (0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1.0)
vol_node.inputs['Density'].default_value = 0.08
vol_node.inputs['Anisotropy'].default_value = 0.3
links.new(vol_node.outputs[0], out_node.inputs['Volume'])

# Helper functions
def create_cylinder(radius, depth, location, rotation=(0,0,0), name="cyl", material=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=radius, depth=depth, location=location, rotation=rotation)
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.name = name
    if material:
        obj.data.materials.append(material)
    return obj

def create_box(size, location, rotation=(0,0,0), name="box", material=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=location, rotation=rotation)
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.scale = (size[0], size[1], size[2])
    obj.name = name
    if material:
        obj.data.materials.append(material)
    return obj

def create_sphere(radius, location, name="sphere", material=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=radius, location=location)
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.name = name
    if material:
        obj.data.materials.append(material)
    return obj

# Create materials
def make_material(name, color, roughness=0.5, metallic=0.0, emission=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    links = mat.node_tree.links
    nodes.clear()
    bsdf = nodes.new('ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if emission > 0:
        bsdf.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = emission
    out = nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
    links.new(bsdf.outputs[0], out.inputs[0])
    return mat

# Materials
mat_asphalt = make_material("Asphalt", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05), roughness=0.9)
mat_concrete = make_material("Concrete", (0.15, 0.15, 0.14), roughness=0.8)
mat_metal = make_material("Metal", (0.3, 0.3, 0.32), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.8)
mat_dark_metal = make_material("DarkMetal", (0.1, 0.1, 0.12), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.7)
mat_glass = make_material("Glass", (0.6, 0.7, 0.8), roughness=0.1, metallic=0.0)
mat_wood = make_material("Wood", (0.3, 0.2, 0.1), roughness=0.7)
mat_coat_dark = make_material("CoatDark", (0.08, 0.08, 0.1), roughness=0.6)
mat_coat_light = make_material("CoatLight", (0.2, 0.18, 0.15), roughness=0.6)
mat_hat = make_material("Hat", (0.1, 0.08, 0.06), roughness=0.5)
mat_skin = make_material("Skin", (0.5, 0.35, 0.25), roughness=0.4)
mat_car_body = make_material("CarBody", (0.02, 0.02, 0.03), roughness=0.3, metallic=0.6)
mat_car_glass = make_material("CarGlass", (0.2, 0.25, 0.3), roughness=0.1)
mat_hangar_wall = make_material("HangarWall", (0.12, 0.12, 0.14), roughness=0.6, metallic=0.3)
mat_hangar_door = make_material("HangarDoor", (0.15, 0.15, 0.17), roughness=0.5, metallic=0.4)
mat_light_warm = make_material("LightWarm", (1.0, 0.8, 0.4), roughness=0.5, emission=5.0)
mat_light_cold = make_material("LightCold", (0.6, 0.7, 1.0), roughness=0.5, emission=3.0)
mat_paper = make_material("Paper", (0.8, 0.75, 0.6), roughness=0.9)
mat_tire = make_material("Tire", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02), roughness=0.9)
mat_prop = make_material("Propeller", (0.1, 0.1, 0.1), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.5)
mat_fuselage = make_material("Fuselage", (0.25, 0.25, 0.28), roughness=0.3, metallic=0.5)
mat_wing = make_material("Wing", (0.2, 0.2, 0.22), roughness=0.3, metallic=0.5)
mat_engine = make_material("Engine", (0.15, 0.15, 0.15), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.7)

# Build the ground/tarmac
ground = create_box((100, 100, 0.1), (0, 0, -0.05), name="Ground", material=mat_asphalt)

# Add some tarmac markings (subtle)
for i in range(5):
    x = -20 + i * 10
    mark = create_box((0.3, 15, 0.02), (x, 0, 0.01), name=f"Marking{i}", material=mat_concrete)

# Hangar in the background
hangar_x = 15
hangar_y = 20
# Main hangar body
hangar_body = create_box((20, 12, 8), (hangar_x, hangar_y, 4), name="HangarBody", material=mat_hangar_wall)
# Hangar roof (slightly sloped - use a wedge)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(hangar_x, hangar_y, 8.5))
roof = bpy.context.active_object
roof.scale = (20, 12, 1)
roof.name = "HangarRoof"
roof.data.materials.append(mat_hangar_wall)
# Rotate roof slightly for slope
roof.rotation_euler = (math.radians(5), 0, 0)

# Hangar door (large opening)
hangar_door = create_box((14, 0.5, 7), (hangar_x, hangar_y - 6.25, 3.5), name="HangarDoor", material=mat_hangar_door)
# Door frame
door_frame_top = create_box((15, 0.8, 0.5), (hangar_x, hangar_y - 6.25, 7.25), name="DoorFrameTop", material=mat_dark_metal)
door_frame_left = create_box((0.5, 0.8, 7.5), (hangar_x - 7.25, hangar_y - 6.25, 3.5), name="DoorFrameLeft", material=mat_dark_metal)
door_frame_right = create_box((0.5, 0.8, 7.5), (hangar_x + 7.25, hangar_y - 6.25, 3.5), name="DoorFrameRight", material=mat_dark_metal)

# Add some windows on hangar
for wx in range(3):
    win_x = hangar_x - 6 + wx * 6
    win = create_box((2, 0.3, 1.5), (win_x, hangar_y - 6.2, 5.5), name=f"HangarWin{wx}", material=mat_glass)

# Propeller plane (DC-3 style)
plane_x = 5
plane_y = 5
plane_z = 1.5

# Fuselage (elongated cylinder)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=1.2, depth=10, location=(plane_x, plane_y, plane_z), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
fuselage = bpy.context.active_object
fuselage.name = "Fuselage"
fuselage.data.materials.append(mat_fuselage)
# Scale to make it more oval
fuselage.scale = (1, 1.2, 1)

# Nose
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=1.2, location=(plane_x - 5, plane_y, plane_z))
nose = bpy.context.active_object
nose.name = "Nose"
nose.scale = (1, 1.2, 1)
nose.data.materials.append(mat_fuselage)

# Tail
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=1.2, radius2=0.3, depth=3, location=(plane_x + 6, plane_y, plane_z + 0.5), rotation=(0, math.radians(-90), 0))
tail = bpy.context.active_object
tail.name = "Tail"
tail.scale = (1, 1.2, 1)
tail.data.materials.append(mat_fuselage)

# Vertical stabilizer
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(plane_x + 7, plane_y, plane_z + 2))
vstab = bpy.context.active_object
vstab.scale = (0.3, 2, 3)
vstab.name = "VStab"
vstab.data.materials.append(mat_fuselage)

# Horizontal stabilizer
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(plane_x + 6.5, plane_y, plane_z + 1))
hstab = bpy.context.active_object
hstab.scale = (0.3, 4, 0.3)
hstab.name = "HStab"
hstab.data.materials.append(mat_fuselage)

# Wings
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(plane_x, plane_y, plane_z - 0.3))
wing = bpy.context.active_object
wing.scale = (4, 14, 0.4)
wing.name = "Wing"
wing.data.materials.append(mat_wing)

# Engine nacelles
for side in [-1, 1]:
    eng_x = plane_x - 3
    eng_y = plane_y + side * 3
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.8, depth=3, location=(eng_x, eng_y, plane_z), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
    eng = bpy.context.active_object
    eng.name = f"Engine{side}"
    eng.scale = (1, 1, 1)
    eng.data.materials.append(mat_engine)
    
    # Propeller
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.15, depth=0.3, location=(eng_x - 1.5, eng_y, plane_z), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
    prop_hub = bpy.context.active_object
    prop_hub.name = f"PropHub{side}"
    prop_hub.data.materials.append(mat_prop)
    
    # Propeller blades
    for b in range(3):
        angle = b * (2 * math.pi / 3)
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(eng_x - 1.6, eng_y + math.sin(angle) * 1.5, plane_z + math.cos(angle) * 1.5))
        blade = bpy.context.active_object
        blade.scale = (0.1, 0.15, 1.5)
        blade.rotation_euler = (0, angle, 0)
        blade.name = f"Blade{side}_{b}"
        blade.data.materials.append(mat_prop)

# Landing gear
for side in [-1, 1]:
    gear_x = plane_x - 2
    gear_y = plane_y + side * 2
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.15, depth=1.5, location=(gear_x, gear_y, 0.75))
    gear = bpy.context.active_object
    gear.name = f"Gear{side}"
    gear.data.materials.append(mat_dark_metal)
    
    # Wheel
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.6, depth=0.4, location=(gear_x, gear_y, 0.3), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
    wheel = bpy.context.active_object
    wheel.name = f"Wheel{side}"
    wheel.data.materials.append(mat_tire)

# Tail wheel
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.3, depth=0.2, location=(plane_x + 6, plane_y, 0.3), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
tail_wheel = bpy.context.active_object
tail_wheel.name = "TailWheel"
tail_wheel.data.materials.append(mat_tire)

# Cockpit windows
for i in range(4):
    wx = plane_x - 4 + i * 0.8
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(wx, plane_y - 1.15, plane_z + 0.5))
    win = bpy.context.active_object
    win.scale = (0.6, 0.1, 0.5)
    win.name = f"CockpitWin{i}"
    win.data.materials.append(mat_glass)

# Passenger windows
for i in range(6):
    wx = plane_x - 2 + i * 1.2
    for side in [-1, 1]:
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(wx, plane_y + side * 1.15, plane_z + 0.3))
        win = bpy.context.active_object
        win.scale = (0.5, 0.1, 0.4)
        win.name = f"PaxWin{i}_{side}"
        win.data.materials.append(mat_glass)

# Car (1940s style sedan)
car_x = -5
car_y = -2
car_z = 0.5

# Car body
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(car_x, car_y, car_z))
car_body = bpy.context.active_object
car_body.scale = (4, 1.8, 1)
car_body.name = "CarBody"
car_body.data.materials.append(mat_car_body)

# Car roof
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(car_x - 0.5, car_y, car_z + 0.8))
car_roof = bpy.context.active_object
car_roof.scale = (2.5, 1.6, 0.6)
car_roof.name = "CarRoof"
car_roof.data.materials.append(mat_car_body)

# Car hood (front)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(car_x - 2.2, car_y, car_z - 0.1))
hood = bpy.context.active_object
hood.scale = (1.5, 1.7, 0.5)
hood.name = "Hood"
hood.data.materials.append(mat_car_body)

# Car trunk (back)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(car_x + 2.2, car_y, car_z - 0.1))
trunk = bpy.context.active_object
trunk.scale = (1.5, 1.7, 0.5)
trunk.name = "Trunk"
trunk.data.materials.append(mat_car_body)

# Car windows
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(car_x - 0.5, car_y + side * 0.9, car_z + 0.7))
    win = bpy.context.active_object
    win.scale = (2, 0.1, 0.5)
    win.name = f"CarWin{side}"
    win.data.materials.append(mat_car_glass)

# Windshield
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(car_x - 1.8, car_y, car_z + 0.6))
windshield = bpy.context.active_object
windshield.scale = (0.3, 1.5, 0.6)
windshield.rotation_euler = (0, math.radians(15), 0)
windshield.name = "Windshield"
windshield.data.materials.append(mat_car_glass)

# Rear window
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(car_x + 1.8, car_y, car_z + 0.6))
rear_win = bpy.context.active_object
rear_win.scale = (0.3, 1.5, 0.5)
rear_win.rotation_euler = (0, math.radians(-10), 0)
rear_win.name = "RearWindow"
rear_win.data.materials.append(mat_car_glass)

# Car wheels
for wx in [-1.5, 1.5]:
    for wy in [-0.9, 0.9]:
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.4, depth=0.3, location=(car_x + wx, car_y + wy, 0.2), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
        wheel = bpy.context.active_object
        wheel.name = f"CarWheel_{wx}_{wy}"
        wheel.data.materials.append(mat_tire)
        
        # Hubcap
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.2, depth=0.32, location=(car_x + wx, car_y + wy, 0.2), rotation=(0, math.radians(90), 0))
        hub = bpy.context.active_object
        hub.name = f"Hubcap_{wx}_{wy}"
        hub.data.materials.append(mat_metal)

# Headlights
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.2, location=(car_x - 2.8, car_y + side * 0.6, car_z))
    hl = bpy.context.active_object
    hl.name = f"Headlight{side}"
    hl.data.materials.append(make_material(f"HL{side}", (1.0, 0.9, 0.5), emission=3.0))

# Taillights
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.15, location=(car_x + 2.8, car_y + side * 0.6, car_z))
    tl = bpy.context.active_object
    tl.name = f"Taillight{side}"
    tl.data.materials.append(make_material(f"TL{side}", (1.0, 0.2, 0.1), emission=2.0))

# Figure 1 (Rick - man in dark coat and fedora)
rick_x = 0
rick_y = -3
rick_z = 0

# Legs
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.12, depth=1.2, location=(rick_x + side * 0.15, rick_y, 0.6))
    leg = bpy.context.active_object
    leg.name = f"RickLeg{side}"
    leg.data.materials.append(mat_coat_dark)

# Torso
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.25, depth=1.0, location=(rick_x, rick_y, 1.7))
rick_torso = bpy.context.active_object
rick_torso.name = "RickTorso"
rick_torso.data.materials.append(mat_coat_dark)

# Coat (longer, wider)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.35, depth=1.3, location=(rick_x, rick_y, 1.4))
rick_coat = bpy.context.active_object
rick_coat.name = "RickCoat"
rick_coat.data.materials.append(mat_coat_dark)

# Head
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.18, location=(rick_x, rick_y, 2.5))
rick_head = bpy.context.active_object
rick_head.name = "RickHead"
rick_head.data.materials.append(mat_skin)

# Fedora hat
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.22, depth=0.05, location=(rick_x, rick_y, 2.65))
rick_hat_brim = bpy.context.active_object
rick_hat_brim.name = "RickHatBrim"
rick_hat_brim.data.materials.append(mat_hat)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.15, depth=0.15, location=(rick_x, rick_y, 2.72))
rick_hat_top = bpy.context.active_object
rick_hat_top.name = "RickHatTop"
rick_hat_top.data.materials.append(mat_hat)

# Arms
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.1, depth=0.9, location=(rick_x + side * 0.35, rick_y, 1.7), rotation=(0, 0, math.radians(20 * side)))
    arm = bpy.context.active_object
    arm.name = f"RickArm{side}"
    arm.data.materials.append(mat_coat_dark)

# Figure 2 (Ilsa - woman in lighter coat and hat)
ilsa_x = 1.5
ilsa_y = -3
ilsa_z = 0

# Legs
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.1, depth=1.1, location=(ilsa_x + side * 0.12, ilsa_y, 0.55))
    leg = bpy.context.active_object
    leg.name = f"IlsaLeg{side}"
    leg.data.materials.append(mat_coat_light)

# Torso
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.22, depth=0.9, location=(ilsa_x, ilsa_y, 1.6))
ilsa_torso = bpy.context.active_object
ilsa_torso.name = "IlsaTorso"
ilsa_torso.data.materials.append(mat_coat_light)

# Coat
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.32, depth=1.2, location=(ilsa_x, ilsa_y, 1.3))
ilsa_coat = bpy.context.active_object
ilsa_coat.name = "IlsaCoat"
ilsa_coat.data.materials.append(mat_coat_light)

# Head
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.16, location=(ilsa_x, ilsa_y, 2.35))
ilsa_head = bpy.context.active_object
ilsa_head.name = "IlsaHead"
ilsa_head.data.materials.append(mat_skin)

# Hat (wider brim, more feminine)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.25, depth=0.04, location=(ilsa_x, ilsa_y, 2.5))
ilsa_hat_brim = bpy.context.active_object
ilsa_hat_brim.name = "IlsaHatBrim"
ilsa_hat_brim.data.materials.append(mat_hat)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.14, depth=0.12, location=(ilsa_x, ilsa_y, 2.56))
ilsa_hat_top = bpy.context.active_object
ilsa_hat_top.name = "IlsaHatTop"
ilsa_hat_top.data.materials.append(mat_hat)

# Arms
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.08, depth=0.8, location=(ilsa_x + side * 0.3, ilsa_y, 1.6), rotation=(0, 0, math.radians(15 * side)))
    arm = bpy.context.active_object
    arm.name = f"IlsaArm{side}"
    arm.data.materials.append(mat_coat_light)

# Airfield lights (tall poles with lights)
for lx in [-15, 0, 15]:
    for ly in [10, -10]:
        # Pole
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.1, depth=6, location=(lx, ly, 3))
        pole = bpy.context.active_object
        pole.name = f"LightPole_{lx}_{ly}"
        pole.data.materials.append(mat_dark_metal)
        
        # Light fixture
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.3, location=(lx, ly, 6))
        light = bpy.context.active_object
        light.name = f"LightFixture_{lx}_{ly}"
        light.data.materials.append(mat_light_warm)

# Add point lights for the airfield lamps
for lx in [-15, 0, 15]:
    for ly in [10, -10]:
        light_data = bpy.data.lights.new(f"AirfieldLight_{lx}_{ly}", type='POINT')
        light_data.energy = 500
        light_data.color = (1.0, 0.8, 0.4)
        light_data.shadow_soft_size = 0.5
        light_obj = bpy.data.objects.new(f"AirfieldLightObj_{lx}_{ly}", light_data)
        scene.collection.objects.link(light_obj)
        light_obj.location = (lx, ly, 6)

# Hangar interior light
hangar_light_data = bpy.data.lights.new("HangarLight", type='POINT')
hangar_light_data.energy = 300
hangar_light_data.color = (0.8, 0.85, 1.0)
hangar_light_obj = bpy.data.objects.new("HangarLightObj", hangar_light_data)
scene.collection.objects.link(hangar_light_obj)
hangar_light_obj.location = (hangar_x, hangar_y - 3, 5)

# Car headlights glow
for side in [-1, 1]:
```
